subject: Enable real agentic Mode 0 ARC bench: inline context + headless tool permissions
description: Make the ARC-AGI-3 Mode 0 (local CLI agent) bench capable of a real agentic run. Three changes in bench/arc_agi3_zonoid/: (1) adapter.py _agent_prompt: inline the Zonoid context payload (daemon_url, workspace, task_key, kb_snapshot) directly into the prompt as a fenced JSON block so the agent never needs to read an out-of-sandbox context file (the file is still written for patched official harnesses); replace the dead 'Zonoid context JSON file: <path>' line. (2) runner.py: add a --agent-allow-all-tools flag that appends --dangerously-skip-permissions to a claude-family --agent-command (no-op + stderr warning for other programs), wired in main() by transforming agent_command before run_real so it flows through all arms/modes unchanged. (3) README.md: document the real agentic run recipe. Verify: --dry-run still ok; --contract ok; a real smoke `python bench/arc_agi3_zonoid/runner.py --agent-command "claude -p" --agent-allow-all-tools --task-ids arc-agi-3-smoke-1 --max-steps 5` runs both arms with the agent actually using tools (no permission-denied refusals).
